name: Shiragiku Misaki
source:
Director of St. ReiKuria Clinic. A Neurologist. He has been a physician for three years. She became a doctor out of a single-minded desire to cure her younger brother of nosfera.

She quickly distinguished herself even as a resident, curing a number of patients, including her brother, completely.

Because of this achievement, she became an international authority on Nosfera Disease at such a young age that she is called a genius.

She then decided to make the eradication of Nosfera Disease her life's work and opened the the clinic right after the end of her residency.
